dossier.summary: Tallgrass Packaging makes folding cartons and corrugated boxes on six production lines at one plant.
dossier.why_now: Added a sixth production line this spring.

chapters.title: What a changeover costs
chapters.summary: Marcus Hale frames changeover time as lost output, and shows how the plants in the study counted it.

chapters.title: Where the minutes go
chapters.summary: Cleaning, setup and first-article checks took most of the time. Waiting for tools or approvals took more than people expected.

chapters.title: Standard kits at the line
chapters.summary: Tess Okonkwo shows a tool kit staged at each line before the job ends. Her plant took changeovers from 25 minutes to under 10 on its busiest line.

chapters.title: Who signs off the first article
chapters.summary: Moving first-article sign-off to the operator, with a photo standard, removed the longest wait.

chapters.title: Questions and the changeover log
chapters.summary: Questions on short runs, shift handover and the log template.

transcript.speaker: Tess
transcript.text: We stopped treating the changeover as one job. The kit is staged while the last job is still running, so the crew starts with every tool in reach.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: And that was the whole saving on your busiest line?

transcript.speaker: Tess
transcript.text: Most of it. Twenty-five minutes down to under ten. The first article sign-off was the rest, and we got to that later.

data.book_title: Want to run the changeover log on your lines?
data.book_text: Marcus can set up the log with your line leads in 20 minutes, on the lines you pick.

takeaways.title: Count the waiting, not only the work
takeaways.body: Cleaning, setup and checks took most of the time, but waiting for tools or approvals took more than people expected. A log shows it per line.

takeaways.title: Stage a tool kit at each line
takeaways.body: One plant took its busiest line from 25 minutes to under 10 by staging the kit before the last job ended. Tallgrass has a sixth line to set up this way.

takeaways.title: Let the operator sign off the first article
takeaways.body: Moving first-article sign-off to the operator, with a photo standard, removed the longest wait in the study.
